feeds.title: One Mom's Battle Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Tina Swithin founder of One Mom's Battle. The mission of One Mom's Battle is to increase awareness of Cluster B personality disorders and Narcissistic Personality Disorder. A blog on divorcing a narcissist. A public page for those experiencing post-separation abuse and narcissistic abuse while navigating a child custody battle in the family court system.

feeds.title: The Law and Mediation Offices of Kelly Chang Blog
feeds.description: Kelly Chang Rickert is the founder of the Law and Mediation Offices of Kelly Chang, APLC, a law firm dedicated to Family Law. Explore the blog section for legal guidance for family law. We consider ourselves among the blessed, for we truly love our work. This is because we know our purpose, and we were gifted with the ability to achieve that purpose. We try the best results for you and your family. This is our purpose as your lawyers. We are proud of our work, and we strive to never take our clients' trust for granted.

feeds.title: Karen Koehler Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Karen Koehler. I'm a lawyer. This blog is made available by the lawyer/law firm publisher for educational purposes as well as to give you general information and a general understanding of the law.

feeds.title: Lag Liv
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lag Liv and this is my blog. In the throes of new motherhood, it was my place to vent, record milestones, and get advice. In a dark time, it was my place to find support. And now, as a full-time attorney and mom of three, it's my platform to share this life that I love so much- and also to memorialize all the things my kids do so I can one day go back and fill in their baby books.

feeds.title: brilliantlegalmind.com Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Brilliant Legal Mind blog! I created this space to help other lawyers and professionals learn about mindfulness meditation. I am Claire E. Parsons, a lawyer, mom, writer, speaker, and leader. I've been a practicing law for more than a decade and started meditating early in my law practice. It changed my life so I started speaking and writing about it and ultimately became certified as a meditation and yoga teacher.

feeds.title: Garvish Immigration Law Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I am Elizabeth L.A. Garvish the Founder of Garvish Immigration Law. This Blog is dedicated to the immigration process as a journey. Garvish Immigration Law Group, LLC is a boutique immigration law firm based in Atlanta, Georgia representing corporate and individual clients across the globe. Our practice is focused exclusively on employment and family-based cases. At Garvish Immigration Law Group, we function with one principle in mind our clients come first.

feeds.title: Law Mother Blog

feeds.title: Law Quill Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Annette Choti, President of Law Quill. I started Law Quill, because of a need expressed to me by small and medium-sized law firms. We provide all of our law firms with free resources, to ensure their success in legal marketing online.

feeds.title: Attorney Mommy
feeds.description: Hello there! Feel free to browse on what I have written so far. My blog aims to consistently provide meaningful and relevant content to all my readers.

feeds.title: Trust Lawyer Mom Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Trust Lawyer Mom! I'm so happy you're here. I'm Kaitlin, a California lawyer, law firm owner, entrepreneur, and mom of three. I am using this blog as a space to provide helpful articles about estate planning, personal finance, and working motherhood for other moms. I want to empower you to take action with regard to your legal affairs and your life!

feeds.title: MothersEsquire Blog
feeds.description: We are Moms. We are Lawyers. We are Master-Negotiators and Multi-Taskers at work and at home. MothersEsquire is dedicated to supporting women lawyers who are balancing the demands of the profession with the joys and challenges of parenthood! Our Mission is to achieve gender equity in the legal profession by improving promotion and retention rates of women in the law, along with championing equal pay and transparency regarding compensation practices in the legal profession.

feeds.title: Davis Law Practice PLLC Blog
feeds.description: Expert advice on divorce, custody, and family law from Nanda Davis, a female divorce attorney in Roanoke, VA. I opened Davis Law Practice in Roanoke, Virginia, in 2014. Since then, I have built a firm that specializes in taking on a limited number of clients to ensure they all get the attention their cases deserve. I love my work, both inside and outside of the courtroom, and I am continually inspired by the resilience and strength of my clients.

feeds.title: Bechailaw Blog

She has presented at various community events and to members of professional organizations.

feeds.title: Native Mommy Lawyer
